title: Away Credit Terms of the Dining Plan
content:
What do the away credit figures of the Dining Plan come to? They are the same on all six plans - the Dining 10, 15, 30, 45 and 60 Meal Plans and the Dining Full Board Plan:

| Plan | Minimum consecutive days away, registered in advance, that earn a plan fee credit | Most days credited per registered absence | Share of the daily plan fee credited per day away | Calendar days before departure by which the absence must be registered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dining 10 Meal Plan | 7 | 30 | 100 percent | 3 |
| Dining 15 Meal Plan | 7 | 30 | 100 percent | 3 |
| Dining 30 Meal Plan | 7 | 30 | 100 percent | 3 |
| Dining 45 Meal Plan | 7 | 30 | 100 percent | 3 |
| Dining 60 Meal Plan | 7 | 30 | 100 percent | 3 |
| Dining Full Board Plan | 7 | 30 | 100 percent | 3 |

## The figures in words

- **7 days**: an absence earns a plan fee credit only when it runs at least 7 consecutive days and is registered in advance.
- **30 days**: no more than 30 days are credited for one registered absence.
- **100 percent**: each credited day is credited at the full daily plan fee.
- **3 calendar days**: the notice period before the first day away by which the absence must be registered.
